For a given task + subsetting variable/value, fit set of pooled models

fit_task_models_pooled.Rd

Fits each model in models as a single-group model to the trials for task where subset_var == subset_val, and saves each one as a ModelRecord at {registry_dir}/{task}/by_{subset_var}/{subset_val}/{task}_{itemtype}_f{nfact}.rds (with itemtype lowercased). See vignette("fitting-irt-models") for a worked example.

Usage

fit_task_models_pooled(
  task_data,
  models,
  priors,
  task,
  subset_var,
  subset_val,
  registry_dir
)

Arguments

task_data

data frame nested by task and grouping variables, with columns item_task, the grouping variable(s) (e.g. language, dataset), and data, a list-column of trial-level data frames with (at least) columns run_id, item_uid, correct (logical or 0/1), and chance (chance level of the item)

models

data frame of models to fit, one per row, with columns nfact (number of factors) and itemtype ("Rasch" or "2PL"), and no other columns

priors

list of priors, where names are parameter names (e.g. d, a1) and values are vectors of length 3 (priorType, val1, val2), e.g. list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3))

task

one value in item_task

subset_var

variable to subset by (string or bare variable); must be a column of task_data (not of the nested data)

subset_val

value to subset to (string)

registry_dir

string indicating directory in which to save models

Value

Called for its side effect of writing model files.

Details

Before fitting, trials with NA correct are dropped, repeated presentations of an item within a run are treated as separate instances whose parameters are constrained to be equal, and item instances with no variance in responses are dropped. Each item's chance is used as its fixed lower asymptote (guessing parameter).
